verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a skills plugin rather than a standalone app, so the AI assistant itself is the host harness's model (Claude Code, Codex, etc.). What Superpowers ships on its own is a delegation workflow: after the user says "go", it dispatches plan tasks to subagents, has a first-party code-reviewer agent check each one, and can run autonomously for hours. A hands-on user confirms the brainstorm-spec, plan, and subagent-implementation flow works and catches issues. Missing for 10: an assistant built into the product itself rather than borrowed from the host agent, and independent corroboration of autonomous delegation beyond a single anecdote.
